text: In the Bench Project at /projects/2/5, create a new task titled 'fwvk8-n1 Bench Task'. Open that task's page and set: a description that includes the text 'fwvk8-n1', due date 2026-12-31, priority High, attach the EXISTING label named 'Backend' (choose it from the suggestions, do not create a new one), and add a comment whose text includes 'fwvk8-n1'. Most fields save automatically. Then report the task's displayed identifier (shown as BENCH-<number>), and confirm the due date, priority, label, description and comment as displayed on the task page.

summary: Created the task 'fwvk8-n1 Bench Task' in Bench Project (/projects/2/5); it opens at /tasks/4 with displayed identifier BENCH-4. On the task page I set a description containing 'fwvk8-n1' ("fwvk8-n1 test description"), due date 2026-12-31 (shown as "31 Dec 2026, 12:00:00"), priority High, and attached the EXISTING label 'Backend' selected from the suggestions (toast confirmed "The label has been added successfully", no new label created). I added a comment containing 'fwvk8-n1' ("fwvk8-n1 comment"). All five values were read back from the live task page.
